risk_statement: Approved supervision or escalation conditions cannot be maintained
mitigation: Pause affected session/pilot and follow approved safeguarding procedure

risk_statement: Pilot records collect unnecessary identifying or private child content
mitigation: Use participant codes and minimal structured fields; stop unnecessary capture

risk_statement: Critical defect prevents safe or meaningful mission use
mitigation: Pause affected flow; controlled fix; rerun regression/browser QA

risk_statement: Arabic experience is materially weaker or misleading compared with English
mitigation: Separate Arabic findings; fix and verify bilingual parity

risk_statement: Interface blocks meaningful participation for intended pilot users
mitigation: Record ACC issue; mitigate or pause affected use; verify fix

risk_statement: Adults misinterpret supported evidence as failure or ranking
mitigation: Re-brief adults; revise interpretation guidance before scale
Lock commit baseline and log any authorized change point
